insights.claim: The init container pattern decouples pipeline compilation from runtime discovery: managed pipeline YAMLs are pre-compiled at image build time and staged to a shared volume at container init, avoiding runtime compilation and network fetches.
insights.reasoning: The Dockerfile runs generate_managed_pipelines at build time (line 23) and the init container either copies prebuilt YAMLs or recompiles only when RELATED_IMAGE overrides require it. This pattern reduces startup latency and avoids runtime dependencies on pipeline source files.
